lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr12Cd6 (reduced formula Zr2Cd) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis identifies two Zr environments: a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Cd and 6 Zr) at 3.1155 Å, and a 10-neighbor Zr environment at 3.1171 Å. Cd centers show 14 geometric neighbors, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 10-vertex Zr polyhedra, and edge-sharing between 12-vertex Zr and 14-vertex Cd polyhedra.
